summary: Armour Residential REIT filed an 8-K announcing a routine monthly cash dividend of $0.24 per common share for May 2026, with a holder of record date of May 15, 2026, and payment date of May 28, 2026. The filing contains no special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The dividend is ordinary course for a REIT aiming to distribute taxable income to maintain REIT status. No strategic review, activist campaign, or corporate action is present. This is an ordinary current report with no special-situation relevance.
